value.quote: Meropenem_source_tables_by_species.xlsx is the single animal and in-vitro data workbook. Its sheets retain source-shaped tables and notes, not a ready-made modeling dataset:

1. Prepare the data. Split the mixed source blocks into PK, PD, MIC and validation inputs. Check provenance, units, dose histories, analytes, matrices, experimental units and missing fields. Identify usable records and unresolved gaps before fitting.

value.quote: Separate routes, analytes (unchanged meropenem, H-4295, total 14C), total versus unbound drug, and plasma, serum, whole blood, ELF, CSF, tissue fluid and tissue homogenate. Keep per-animal and per-kilogram parameters apart, and keep neutropenic, renally impaired, septic, infected, pregnant and repeat-dose animals apart from healthy single-dose animals. In vitro DHP-I kinetics are not PK.
